The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Says apps should call each other through services or selectors, not import another app's models, with the mechanism (circular imports and schema changes rippling)
- Adds CORS with an explicit origin allow-list from the environment and the middleware placed before CommonMiddleware, and notes CORS is separate from CSRF
- Asks before adding the django-cors-headers dependency

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
